title: AeshConsole exception happening randomly when killing continuous testing
body:
## Describe the bug

Exception happening randomly when killing continuous testing (using main):
```
Exception in thread "Aesh InputStream Reader"
java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to read io/quarkus/deployment/dev/console/AeshConsole$4.class
```
